capabilities: View .xnote handwritten notes on desktop and mobile
Render n-notes flow text with headings, lists, checkboxes, code, tables and links
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; bundles fflate (MIT); release can be verified with GitHub artifact attestation; marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .xnote handwritten note files, so notes created in the xnotes Android app are unreadable in the vault.

relations.evidence: Read-only viewer for .xnote handwritten notes from the xnotes Android app

summary: Read-only viewer that displays .xnote handwritten notes from the xnotes Android app inside an Obsidian vault.
